Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a multi-lane roadway in Conroe, Texas, when Driver 1 signaled and moved
left to change lanes. Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the left lane, was alongside and the two vehicles made contact,
with Driver 2's vehicle striking the left side of Driver 1's vehicle along the rear quarter panel and door. A Passenger
was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision. Driver 1 stated that the impact
jolted their body forward and then back against the seat, and reported lower back pain at the scene. Damage to
Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with a sideswipe of this type, with scraping and dented panels on the left side and no
other damage observed. Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events as described by Driver 1. Two independent
witnesses at the scene gave statements consistent with the account, and photographs taken at the scene match the
damage pattern. Officers confirmed the presence of Driver 1 and the Passenger in the vehicle upon arrival. Driver 1 is
listed as the named insured on the vehicle's policy. No prior damage to the vehicle was reported or observed by the
responding officers.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
